name: speed-graph
description: Explore very large vaults in a graph view that stays smooth, with filters, local graph, optional 3D, shape layouts and gentle motion effects.

scripts.build:wasm: cd core && wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir pkg && rm -f pkg/.gitignore && perl -i -ne 'print unless /eslint-disable|tslint:disable/' pkg/*.d.ts && cp pkg/fastgraph_core_bg.wasm ../src/generated/core.wasm
